text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I was able to trade a lot of these items for cheap, so I'll give them to you, too. Hehe♪ If you use my Alchemy Master Mar Secret Negotiator skill, you'll have plenty of time to spare. ...Huh? You wanna see? Oh well, just this once, okay? Ahem.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このアイテム、
大量に安値で取引できたから
君にもあげるよ。
ふふ♪　
私の『錬金堂店主マル秘交渉術』を使えば余裕だったわ。
……え、
見たい？　
しゃあないな～、
一回だけね？　
コホン。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Uncle~. Sono~, I don't have any money at all~... I wish you'd give me a discount... Pfft... Well, like this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね
えねえ、
おじちゃ～ん。
ソノね～、
お金これしかもってないんだぁ～……
安くしてほしいなぁ……
ぷぅ……
ま、
こんな感じ？
